description: NSW Crime Tool is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by NSW Bureau of Crime Statistics and Research. Summary statistics and interactive maps showing data on criminal incidents, victims and alleged offenders in NSW. Data is available on local government areas (LGAs), suburbs and postcodes. Data can also be examined on sex, age and Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander status. LGA data is available from 2018 onwards. Data tables available for download in CSV format. Coverage is the states and territories, 2018 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as quarterly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
